description: 索尼于2001年推出的数码相机。

specs.英文简介: The MVC-FD87 was one of the Mavica series of digital cameras from Sony, announced at the February, 2001, PMA show alongside the MVC-FD75, MVC-FD92, and MVC-FD97Sony press release, from [http://www.dpreview.com/news/2001/2/14/newsonys "Seven new Sony's"] at [http://www.dpreview.com/ DPReview.com]—the fourth generation of Mavicas using standard 3.5" computer floppy disks for image storage.
